user.title: IntuiBase Radio
user.description: Configure the radio and its optional sidebar dashboard.

data_description.dashboard_name: Name displayed in the sidebar (default: Radio).
data_description.excluded_players: Media players that should not appear in the radio output list.
data_description.stations: One station per line. Enter a name or Name = search phrase, e.g. Polskie Radio Jedynka = Jedynka. Add, remove or reorder stations. At least one station is required; names must be unique.

error.invalid_stations: Enter at least one station. Each line must have a unique name and a nonempty search phrase after = if used.
